priya: quick RFC follow-up: propose a 'fluid canary' that emits a continuous target_frac f(t) to make cutovers smooth. want feedback on policy surface and runtime tradeoffs.
jason: +1. main concerns: affinity and runtime cost.
priya: affinity modes: sticky-hash (deterministic hash(session_id) < f) or drain-on-next-request. policy picks affinity.
maria: health signals: err_rate_pct, p95_ms, optional quality_delta. controller computes a configurable composite S.
lia: runtime should compute routing once per session for streaming; use epoch in hash to allow controlled rehashing.
priya: abort logic: require M consecutive windows above threshold + min_stable_seconds before rollback; cooldown after rollback.
